sentences.text:
It is pointed out that insofar as lands of the petitioners are concerned, same came to be notified as per the preliminary notification dated 19.10.1989 under Section 4(1) of the Land Acquisition Act,
1894 (for short 'the Act').
It is submitted that awards were passed on 16.11.1992 pursuant to the final notification and the said awards were also rectified on 02.04.1994.

It is pointed out that several other land owners had put forward their claim - 11 - NC: 2023:KHC:24773 for enhancement in LAC No.13/1997 which was clubbed with other land acquisition cases and disposed off on 30.03.2010 fixing the compensation amount at Rs.8,000/- per cent of land.

Petitioners state that they filed application as per Annexure - E dated 28.10.2010 (Annexure-D in W.P.No.13806/2023) under Section 28A of the Act seeking for re-determination of compensation in terms of the enhancement made in LAC No. 13/1997.
3.

It is submitted that the respondents issued a communication on 22.03.2011 as per Annexure-F (Annexure-E in W.P.No.13806/2023) pointing out that an appeal had been preferred and after disposal of appeal, application under Section 28-A would be considered.

It is submitted that the appeal before the High Court came to be finalized on 22.04.2014 in M.F.A.No. 4361/2011 and accordingly, the award in LAC No. 13/1997 came to be modified and confirmed at Rs.7,000/- per cent.
It is noticed that the application for re-determination is filed - 12 - NC: 2023:KHC:24773 within time after taking note of the time spent in obtaining certified copy.

4. Learned AGA submits upon instructions of Sri. Prashanth, FDA from the Office of the Special Land Acquisition Officer and Assistant Commissioner, Mangalore, who is present in Court that the orders cannot be passed piecemeal and all the matters which are pending for similar relief have to be disposed off.

entities.text: Office of the Special Land Acquisition Officer
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Learned AGA further submits that reasonable period of 8 months may be granted from the date of receipt of certified copy of the order to dispose off the entire bunch of matters seeking similar reliefs.

5. Recording the said submission, petitions are disposed off in light of the submission that 28-A applications filed by the petitioners and other land owners pending before respondent No.3 shall be disposed off - 13 - Rukkayya vs The Government Of Karnataka on 17 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/141893245/
9 NC: 2023:KHC:24773 within a period of 8 months from the date of receipt of copy of this order in accordance with law.

opennyai_summary.facts:
It is submitted that awards were passed on 16.11.1992 pursuant to the final notification and the said awards were also rectified on 02.04.1994.
Petitioners state that they filed application as per Annexure - E dated 28.10.2010 (Annexure-D in W.P.No.13806/2023) under Section 28A of the Act seeking for re-determination of compensation in terms of the enhancement made in LAC No. 13/1997.
3.
It is submitted that the respondents issued a communication on 22.03.2011 as per Annexure-F (Annexure-E in W.P.No.13806/2023) pointing out that an appeal had been preferred and after disposal of appeal, application under Section 28-A would be considered.
It is submitted that the appeal before the High Court came to be finalized on 22.04.2014 in M.F.A.No. 4361/2011 and accordingly, the award in LAC No. 13/1997 came to be modified and confirmed at Rs.7,000/- per cent.
